models.future_plan: Multi-Model Swarm (Specialized 4B models for coding, creative, etc.)

capabilities: Read and write text notes (.txt) in the notes directory
Read source code files (.js, .json) recursively from the project root
Search the internet via Serper.dev, DuckDuckGo, and Wikipedia
Retrieve local system time and convert timezones
Analyze entire code directories by reading multiple files at once
Maintain persistent memory (SQLite for facts, JSON for procedures/knowledge)
Reflect on past sessions and extract procedural rules
limitations: Cannot execute arbitrary shell commands or terminal scripts
Cannot modify or write to source code files (read-only access to code)
Cannot send emails or make network requests outside of defined web search tools
Cannot access the system clipboard or interact with the OS UI
